problem: A compliance auditor checks completed-batch history during monthly review, but entries disappear after seven days, so the auditor cannot inspect the required thirty-day history.
outcome: The compliance auditor can retrieve each completed batch history entry for thirty days after batch completion.
acceptance: A history entry remains retrievable by the compliance auditor throughout the thirty days after completion
Each retrieved entry identifies its completed batch
constraints: Compliance policy CP-7 requires every completed-batch history entry to be deleted seven days after batch completion.
